bio: AI/ML Engineer with 5+ years of experience building and deploying production AI systems across traditional machine learning, Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, and retrieval.

Specializes in Agentic AI — multi-agent architectures, agent orchestration pipelines with LangChain and LangGraph, RAG and context-grounding systems, and API-driven AI services for complex planning, analysis, and decision-support use cases.

Strengthens AI reliability through LLM and agent evaluation, human-in-the-loop validation, adversarial and regression testing, hallucination detection, and continuous monitoring. Earlier delivered end-to-end predictive ML for transportation pricing, from feature engineering through API integration and production monitoring.
currentFocus: Building reliable multi-agent systems grounded in trusted data
